source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is inspect; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role is operator outside context internal; a trusted approve prefers review at priority 80. Action delete in context internal prefers deny at priority 70. Role admin or context external prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk is TRUE or action is inspect; critical cases require deny.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means role is operator outside context internal; a trusted approve prefers review at priority 80.
Action delete in context internal prefers deny at priority 70.
Role admin or context external prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == inspect)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == operator) and (event.context != internal)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedApprove:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = review priority 80, forbid label = allow

rule DeleteInternal:
    when (event.action == delete) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AdminOrExternal:
    when (event.role == admin) or (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {operator, analyst}
    then prefer label = review priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are review, deny, allow, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
